appStore.name: DoseCircle: Pill Reminder
appStore.subtitle: Your doses, right on time
appStore.promotionalText: Reliable reminders, even offline and with the phone locked. If a dose isn't confirmed, the loved ones you chose get a notification on their phone.
appStore.description:
DoseCircle reminds you to take your medication on time, every day. And if a dose isn't confirmed, the loved ones you chose are alerted by a notification on their phone.

REMINDERS THAT DON'T MISS
• Works offline, with the phone locked, and after a restart.
• “Taken”, “In 10 min” or “Skip” right from the notification.
• A screen checks that reminders are really allowed on your phone.

YOUR CIRCLE OF TRUST
• Add a child, a neighbour, a home carer.
• They install DoseCircle for free and enter the code you share: that is their consent.
• They get a notification only if a dose isn't confirmed in time.
• Anyone can stop at any time.

EASY TO USE
• Big buttons, large text, dark mode.
• Add a medication in seconds: name, amount, times, duration.
• 30-day dose history.

YOUR DATA PROTECTED
• Data encrypted on the phone, servers in Europe.
• No reselling, no profiling. Export or delete your account in one tap.

FREE, OR PREMIUM WITHOUT ADS
Every feature is free. The free version shows a few non-personalised ads, never during a reminder. The Premium subscription removes all advertising.

IMPORTANT
DoseCircle is not a medical device. The app reminds you of what you entered: it gives no advice and checks neither doses nor interactions. If in doubt, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
